name: ai-usage-taskbar-widget
description: Taskbar AI token usage monitor widget with multi-account authentication and 4 visual themes

scripts.build: npm run build:native && tsc && vite build
scripts.update-app: npm run build && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Copy-Item -Path dist,dist-electron,native,public,package.json -Destination dist-release\win-unpacked\resources\app -Recurse -Force; Copy-Item -Path native,public -Destination dist-release\win-unpacked -Recurse -Force"

author: Antigravity
